levels.note: gear 1st/99th pct luminance (measured at apply time) moved halfway toward the scene black/white, max 22 levels; applied to luminance only (RGB offsets added), so chroma and hue are kept

tint.note: per-channel gains = 0.5 x key-light chroma + local wall chroma (0.12 if the key light is warm, else 0.03), luminance-neutral, capped +/-5%

gradient.note: multiplicative 1+amp_x*x+amp_y*y across the gear box, x,y in [-1,1]
